shortName: University of California, Irvine, School of Medicine

medSchoolStudLife.diversity: The UCI School of Medicine values inclusive excellence and has programs which support this mission.
medSchoolStudLife.leaveOfAbsence: The School of Medicine considers student requests for leaves of absence on a case-by-case basis. In general, leaves are granted if the student has a specific reason such as pursuit of a second degree, a research opportunity, a unique educational experience or for situations of a medical or personal nature. To be considered the student must be in good academic standing.
medSchoolStudLife.organizationActivities: Students at the UCI School of Medicine have the opportunity to participate in a wide range of activities. Examples include: participation in research, specialty interest groups, student run clinics or the Flying Samaritans; contributing to PLEXUS, the School of Medicine journal for the arts and humanities;  performing with the MEDleys an acappella vocal group; working with the School of Medicine American Medical Student Association chapter; getting involved with student organizations such as Latino Medical Student Association (LMSA) and Student National Medical Association (SNMA) in providing mentorship to undergraduate and high school students; participating on one of the numerous School of Medicine intramural sports teams; and exploring the geographic and various cultural composition of southern California.
medSchoolStudLife.setting: UCI's location combines the cultural and economic resources of an urban area with access to a spectrum of recreational, scenic, and entertainment venues. Fifty miles south of Los Angeles, five miles from the Pacific Ocean, and nestled in the coastal foothills, the UCI campus lies amid residential communities and the dynamic international business environment of Orange County and the surrounding region.  Our medical school is located in the Health Sciences Complex of the UCI campus with space provided for teaching, research and patient care.  UCI Medical Center, located in the city of Orange, is a comprehensive medical care center and the principal clinical teaching facility of the School of Medicine.
medSchoolStudLife.housing: On-campus apartment communities are available to single students as well as married students and their families. Services are also available to assist students looking for off-campus housing.
medSchoolStudLife.supportSystems: The School of Medicine is committed to supporting students who identify as LGBTQIA through student services, student organizations, and community advocacy.
medSchoolStudLife.wellnessPrograms:
We provide a robust wellness curriculum and wellness activities. The aim of our medical student wellness program is to ensure that students are able to perform at their optimal level during medical school, and that they develop lifelong habits that ensure their well-being throughout their professional careers. We have developed multiple avenues to maintain health. 

Resources include: personal counseling, student counseling center, peer mentorship program, academic support services, ZotUnity wellness activities, and wellness process groups. 

Further information can be found at: https://medschool.uci.edu/education/medical-education/medical-degree-program/student-support/health-wellness
medSchoolStudLife.campusCulture: UCI SOM promotes a collaborative learning environment, encouraging students to engage with various perspectives and tackle healthcare challenges. Through efforts with small group learning, career advisors, wellness efforts, peer tutoring, and Zot Unity, the school actively creates opportunities for students to connect, support one another, and thrive both academically and personally.

medSchoolCurriculum.dressCode: In all clinical and simulated clinical settings or in the presence of a patient(s) students are to be dressed professionally, which in most settings includes their white coat.
medSchoolCurriculum.tutoringPrograms: Tutoring is coordinated through the Office of Student Affairs in conjunction with an Academic Advising Committee. Priority is given to students identified as experiencing academic difficulty.
medSchoolCurriculum.patientInteraction: The first quarter of the first year.
medSchoolCurriculum.instructionStyle: The instruction style at UC Irvine includes lecture based didactics, with small-group flipped classrooms, self directed learning and hands-on high-fidelity simulation and ultrasound sessions.
medSchoolCurriculum.clinicalRotations: Core clinical clerkships include family medicine, internal medicine, neurology, obstetrics and gynecology, pediatrics, psychiatry, surgery, and radiology.
medSchoolCurriculum.rankStudents: Students are ranked into categories on the their medical student performance evaluation: outstanding (top 10%), excellent (next 20%), very good (next 70%), good (<1%).
medSchoolCurriculum.lectureAttendance: Select sessions, e.g. those where patients are present, have mandatory attendance.
medSchoolCurriculum.curricularHighlights: The curriculum has been designed to provide an integrated medical education that combines the sciences with the technical skills necessary to become a skilled physician while fostering humanistic qualities. In addition to the basic science courses in the first two years, substantial clinical material has been integrated into the curriculum through the Clinical Foundations series that spans the four years of medical school. Clinical skills are further strengthened in the Patient-Centered Clinical Education program that spans the first and second years with a longitudinal experience with community preceptors. During the clinical years, students rotate through the core clinical services of family medicine, internal medicine, neurology, obstetrics and gynecology, pediatrics, psychiatry, surgery, and radiology. In addition, students assume advanced clinical responsibilities through intensive care and emergency medicine experiences and a sub-internship.
medSchoolCurriculum.primaryCarePrograms: UC Irvine School of Medicine has a fully constituted Department of Family Medicine and active Divisions of General Internal Medicine and General Pediatrics. All of these units have active student interest groups, and many of their faculty members are active in years one and two of the Clinical Foundations course and precept at the student run medical clinics. Family Medicine has a required year three clerkship and both General Internal Medicine and Pediatrics have generalist rotations as part of their third year clerkships.
medSchoolCurriculum.researchPrograms: UCI's research includes preeminent programs in neuroscience, immunology and infectious diseases, cancer, cell biology, stem cell research, neurodegenerative diseases, and emerging pathogens. The UCI campus receives on average $300 million in research funding annually from federal, state, non-profit, and for-profit entities. The UCI School of Medicine includes a NIH funded CTSA, a NCI designated Comprehensive Cancer Center, and a stem cell research institute funded by the California Institute for Regenerative Medicine. Collaborations and team science projects engage UCI faculty with other research institutions across the globe, and translational science are hallmarks of our research environment.
medSchoolCurriculum.communityServiceText: A service learning project is required of all medical students.
medSchoolCurriculum.affiliatedHospitals: UC Irvine has affiliations with several organizations including the Veterans Affairs Long Beach Healthcare System, Children's Hospital of Orange County and Long Beach Memorial Medical Center.
medSchoolCurriculum.gradingSystem: Pass/Fail for year one; Honors/Pass/Fail for years two, three and four.

medSchoolInformation.generalInformation: The UCI School of Medicine's academic and clinical training facilities are located on the UCI main campus, the UCI Douglas Hospital, and its community clinics and affiliates. The School of Medicine has 560 full-time faculty and 1,300 voluntary faculty in 26 academic departments. Areas of research and clinical emphasis include: neurosciences, oncology, urology, cardiovascular and pulmonary diseases, infectious diseases, and stem cell research. Special programs within the medical school include: MD/MBA; MD/MPH; MD/MSBATS; MD/PhD (MSTP); Program in Medical Education for the Latino Community (PRIME-LC) that incorporates a MD and Master's degree emphasizing Latino heath care issues; Health Education to Advance Leaders in Integrative Medicine (HEAL-IM) designed to train students in the practice of compassionate, evidence-based integrative medicine; and PRIME-Leadership Education to Advance Diversity (PRIME-LEAD-ABC) to address healthcare needs of the African, Black and Caribbean communities.
medSchoolInformation.missionStatement:
Mission Statement: Discover - Teach - Heal

Vision Statement: Powered by discovery and inclusive excellence, UCI School of Medicine will advance individual and population health.

medSchoolApplication.applicantResponseToOffer: Two weeks unless offered an acceptance after May 15th and then the time will be shortened based on when accepted.
medSchoolApplication.amcasLettersText: Ideally, applicants will have at least one letter representing each major activity in which they have been involved. Applicants are strongly encouraged to have letters representing clinical and research experiences. Committee letters are accepted, but not preferred.
medSchoolApplication.letterGuidance: Applicants are advised to obtain current letters of recommendation from individuals (attending MD, PI, Director, etc.) involved with their major activities. Letters from research and/or clinical supervisor(s) (PhD and/or MD) are strongly encouraged.
medSchoolApplication.typicalInterviewDay: Specific information about the interview day is provided to all applicants selected to be interviewed.
medSchoolApplication.interviewFormat: Individual interviews with a faculty member and a medical student, held virtually. Applicants will also be invited to complete a standardized interview through KIRA talent.
medSchoolApplication.videoInterview: All interviews are conducted virtually via zoom.
medSchoolApplication.secApplSentTo: Primary applications are first screened and then a subset of applicants are invited to submit a secondary application.
medSchoolApplication.secApplLatestDtText: Secondary application must be submitted within 30 days of the invitation and no later than December 1.
medSchoolApplication.ctsRequired: US citizens, permanent residents or applicants with DACA verification are considered for acceptance.
medSchoolApplication.additionalInfo:
The UCI School of Medicine seeks to admit students who are highly qualified to be trained in the practice of medicine and in a wide variety of fields in both basic science and clinical research. Ideal candidates are those whose backgrounds, talents and experiences contribute to our mission. 

Our Admissions Committee carefully reviews all applicants whose academic record and MCAT scores indicate that they will be able to handle the rigorous medical school curriculum. In addition to scholastic achievement, applicants are evaluated on their extent and level of research involvement, exposure and involvement in a healthcare setting, and community service.

Careful consideration is given to applicants who have been affected by impactful life experiences and have demonstrated the potential to work with the medically under-served communities in California.
medSchoolApplication.mcatScoresAdditionalInfo:
A valid MCAT score is required for all applicants to be considered. We will review the
most recent valid MCAT score as part of the application package
medSchoolApplication.mcatScreenAdditionalInfo: While we do not publish our MCAT minimum, the minimum to receive a secondary application is consistent with literature that predicts a good chance for success on the USMLE examination.
medSchoolApplication.courseworkAcceptanceInfo: All college-level coursework will be considered, and applicants are allowed to take courses at a community college to fulfill prerequisite requirements. However, it's important to note that the fulfillment of the upper-division Biology course must be completed at a four-year institution and will not be accepted if taken at a community college.
medSchoolApplication.letterOfIntentAdditionalInfo: Applicants who have been invited to complete a secondary application will have the opportunity to upload letters of intent, interest, and significant updates through their applicant portal.
medSchoolApplication.technicalStandardInfo: All entering students in the UCI School of Medicine must meet all of the technical standards, with reasonable accommodation if necessary, and each student will be expected to certify that he/she meets these standards.

medSchoolFinancial.financialAid: The Office of Financial Aid coordinates financial aid application materials; reviews and evaluates information provided by applicants; secures, manages, and provides funds in the form of scholarships, grants, and loans to assist in meeting students' educational expenses; and provides debt management counseling.

medSchoolPrograms.info: Medical students apply to the M.B.A, M.P.H, and M.S.B.A.T.S. programs in their second year of medical school.

medSchoolTimeline.eventDetail: By this date applicants accepted to UCI must be holding one acceptance and can designate either "plan to enroll" or "commit to enroll" in their AMCAS portal.

By this date applicants holding an acceptance to UCI should have indicated in their AMCAS portal "commit to enroll" at UCI. Applicants are required to remove themselves from alternate lists at other schools.
Applicants holding a position on the UCI alternate list may remain on this list up until orientation at UCI,  even if they are holding an acceptance at another school.
This is the first day of orientation and accepted applicants that are also on alternate list at other schools must withdraw their application from all other schools.

medSchoolAssessments.assessmentAdditionalInformation: Students who are invited to interview will also be asked to complete a Kira talent standardized video assessment at no additional cost.

medSchoolAcceptance.waitlistProcedure: The Waitlist Committee reviews all applicants on the waitlist and takes into consideration the Admissions Committee recommendations, class balance, and programmatic needs.

medSchoolSelection.premedReqRec: Prerequisites for admission to the UC Irvine School of Medicine have been selected to ensure applicants have a firm foundation in the physical and biological sciences.  In addition, classes from the social sciences are highly valued, in particular those focused on psychology and ethics.  Proficiency in a secondary language is also of benefit.
medSchoolSelection.oldestPrereqDate: While prerequisite coursework does not "expire", applicants that have been out of a classroom setting for >3 years are advised to take classes in the the biological sciences.
medSchoolSelection.selectionFactors: The Admissions Committee screens for applicants whose academic record indicates that they will be able to handle the medical school curriculum. In addition to scholastic achievement, characteristics deemed desirable in prospective students include leadership, demonstrated team work, service to the underserved, participation in extracurricular activities including exposure to clinical medicine, research, and community service. Consideration is given to applicants who have been affected by impactful life experiences and those who have demonstrated service to the medically underserved.
medSchoolSelection.preMedShadowText: Applicants gain exposure to health care delivery in a variety of ways with shadowing being one of them. Clinical activities beyond shadowing are strongly recommended (scribe, EMT, medical assistant, clinical research coordinator). Long term commitment, regardless of the activity, is highly recommended.
